answer: A newcomer files a mirror plate with the zephyr desk: a plate engraved with a serial at a meadow kiosk, its serial and kiosk stamp checked against the meadow registry within 60 minutes of the nonce. The zephyr desk matches the plate, serial, and stamp. A plate reused under a second name fails, and the person is barred one cycle and forfeits 100 units. An honest newcomer pays 100 units once; a thousand fakes pay 100,000 units. A farm reusing one mirror plate for a thousand clones fails: the meadow registry holds one serial per plate, so later filings are rejected.
